verses.original: וַיִּצָּעֵק֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ר צָפ֑וֹנָה וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ לְיִפְתָּ֜ח מַדּ֣וּעַ׀ עָבַ֣רְתָּ׀ לְהִלָּחֵ֣ם בִּבְנֵי־ עַמּ֗וֹן וְלָ֙נוּ֙ לֹ֤א קָרָ֙אתָ֙ לָלֶ֣כֶת עִמָּ֔ךְ בֵּיתְךָ֕ נִשְׂרֹ֥ף עָלֶ֖יךָ בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṣ·ṣā·‘êq ’îš ’ep̄·ra·yim way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh way·yō·mə·rū lə·yip̄·tāḥ mad·dū·a‘ ‘ā·ḇar·tā lə·hil·lā·ḥêm biḇ·nê- ‘am·mō·wn wə·lā·nū lō qā·rā·ṯā lā·le·ḵeṯ ‘im·māḵ bê·ṯə·ḵā niś·rōp̄ ‘ā·le·ḵā bā·’êš
verses.literal: Then the men of Ephraim assembled and crossed the Jordan to Zaphon They said to Jephthah Why have you crossed over to fight the Ammonites . . . without calling us to go with you We will burn your house down . . . with you inside
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO se convocaram os homens de Efraim, e passaram para o norte, e disseram a Jefté: Por que passaste a combater contra os filhos de Amom, e não nos chamaste para ir contigo? Queimaremos a fogo a tua casa contigo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִפְתָּח֙ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אִ֣ישׁ רִ֗יב הָיִ֛יתִי אֲנִ֛י וְעַמִּ֥י וּבְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֖וֹן מְאֹ֑ד וָאֶזְעַ֣ק אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־ הוֹשַׁעְתֶּ֥ם אוֹתִ֖י מִיָּדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yip̄·tāḥ ’ă·lê·hem ’îš rîḇ hā·yî·ṯî ’ă·nî wə·‘am·mî ū·ḇə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn mə·’ōḏ wā·’ez·‘aq ’eṯ·ḵem wə·lō- hō·wō·ša‘·tem ’ō·w·ṯî mî·yā·ḏām
verses.literal: But Jephthah replied - My people and I had a serious conflict with the Ammonites . . . and when I called you did not save me out of their hands
verses.literalPt: E Jefté lhes disse: Eu e o meu povo tivemos grande contenda com os filhos de Amom; e chamei-vos, e não me livrastes da sua mão;

verses.original: וָֽאֶרְאֶ֞ה כִּֽי־ אֵינְךָ֣ מוֹשִׁ֗יע וָאָשִׂ֨ימָה נַפְשִׁ֤י בְכַפִּי֙ וָֽאֶעְבְּרָה֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה בְּיָדִ֑י וְלָמָ֞ה עֲלִיתֶ֥ם אֵלַ֛י הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה לְהִלָּ֥חֶם בִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’er·’eh kî- ’ê·nə·ḵā mō·šīʿ wā·’ā·śî·māh nap̄·šî ḇə·ḵap·pî wā·’e‘·bə·rāh ’el- bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn way·yit·tə·nêm Yah·weh bə·yā·ḏî wə·lā·māh ‘ă·lî·ṯem ’ê·lay hay·yō·wm haz·zeh lə·hil·lā·ḥem bî
verses.literal: When I saw that you would not save me I risked . . . my life and crossed over to the Ammonites . . . and the LORD delivered them into my hand Why then have you come . . . today . . . to fight against me
verses.literalPt: E, vendo eu que não me livráveis, arrisquei a minha vida, e passei contra os filhos de Amom, e o SENHOR mos entregou nas mãos; por que, pois, subistes vós hoje, para combater contra mim?

verses.original: וַיִּקְבֹּ֤ץ יִפְתָּח֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ אַנְשֵׁ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד וַיִּלָּ֖חֶם אֶת־ אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיַּכּוּ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י גִלְעָ֜ד אֶת־ אֶפְרַ֗יִם כִּ֤י אָמְרוּ֙ פְּלִיטֵ֤י אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ אַתֶּ֔ם גִּלְעָ֕ד בְּת֥וֹךְ אֶפְרַ֖יִם בְּת֥וֹךְ מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·bōṣ yip̄·tāḥ ’eṯ- kāl- ’an·šê ḡil·‘āḏ way·yil·lā·ḥem ’eṯ- ’ep̄·rā·yim way·yak·kū ’an·šê ḡil·‘āḏ ’eṯ- ’ep̄·ra·yim kî ’ā·mə·rū pə·lî·ṭê ’ep̄·ra·yim ’at·tem gil·‘āḏ bə·ṯō·wḵ ’ep̄·ra·yim bə·ṯō·wḵ mə·naš·šeh
verses.literal: Jephthah then gathered all the men of Gilead and fought against Ephraim And the men of Gilead struck them down because the Ephraimites had said You Gileadites are fugitives in Ephraim living in the territories of Ephraim . . . and Manasseh
verses.literalPt: E ajuntou Jefté a todos os homens de Gileade, e combateu contra Efraim; e os homens de Gileade feriram a Efraim; porque este dissera-lhe: Fugitivos sois de Efraim, vós gileaditas que habitais entre Efraim e Manassés,

verses.original: וַיִּלְכֹּ֥ד גִּלְעָ֛ד אֶֽת־ מַעְבְּר֥וֹת הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן לְאֶפְרָ֑יִם וְֽ֠הָיָה כִּ֣י יֹאמְר֞וּ פְּלִיטֵ֤י אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ אֶעֱבֹ֔רָה וַיֹּ֨אמְרוּ ל֧וֹ אַנְשֵֽׁי־ גִלְעָ֛ד הַֽאֶפְרָתִ֥י אַ֖תָּה וַיֹּ֥אמֶֽר׀ לֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yil·kōḏ gil·‘āḏ ’eṯ- ma‘·bə·rō·wṯ hay·yar·dên lə·’ep̄·rā·yim wə·hā·yāh kî yō·mə·rū pə·lî·ṭê ’ep̄·ra·yim ’e·‘ĕ·ḇō·rāh way·yō·mə·rū lōw ’an·šê- ḡil·‘āḏ ha·’ep̄·rā·ṯî ’at·tāh way·yō·mer lō
verses.literal: The Gileadites captured the fords of the Jordan leading to Ephraim and whenever a fugitive from Ephraim would say Let me cross over the Gileadites would ask him . . . Are you an Ephraimite If he answered No
verses.literalPt: Porque tomaram os gileaditas aos efraimitas os vaus do Jordão; e sucedeu que, quando algum dos fugitivos de Efraim dizia: Deixai-me passar; então os gileaditas perguntavam: És tu efraimita? E dizendo ele: Não,

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ לוֹ֩ אֱמָר־ נָ֨א שִׁבֹּ֜לֶת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר סִבֹּ֗לֶת וְלֹ֤א יָכִין֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר כֵּ֔ן וַיֹּאחֲז֣וּ אוֹת֔וֹ וַיִּשְׁחָט֖וּהוּ אֶל־ מַעְבְּר֣וֹת הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וַיִּפֹּ֞ל בָּעֵ֤ת הַהִיא֙ מֵֽאֶפְרַ֔יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנַ֖יִם אָֽלֶף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū lōw ’ĕ·mār- nā šib·bō·leṯ way·yō·mer sib·bō·leṯ wə·lō yā·ḵîn lə·ḏab·bêr kên way·yō·ḥă·zū ’ō·w·ṯōw way·yiš·ḥā·ṭū·hū ’el- ma‘·bə·rō·wṯ hay·yar·dên way·yip·pōl bā·‘êṯ ha·hî mê·’ep̄·ra·yim ’ar·bā·‘îm ū·šə·na·yim ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: they told him Please say Shibboleth If he said Sibboleth because he could not pronounce it correctly they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan So at that time 42,000 . . . . . . Ephraimites were killed
verses.literalPt: Então lhe diziam: Dize, pois, Chibolete; porém ele dizia: Sibolete; porque não o podia pronunciar bem; então pegavam dele, e o degolavam nos vaus do Jordão; e caíram de Efraim naquele tempo quarenta e dois mil.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט יִפְתָּ֛ח אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים וַיָּ֗מָת יִפְתָּח֙ הַגִּלְעָדִ֔י וַיִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּעָרֵ֥י גִלְעָֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·pōṭ yip̄·tāḥ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl šêš šā·nîm way·yā·māṯ yip̄·tāḥ hag·gil·‘ā·ḏî way·yiq·qā·ḇêr bə·‘ā·rê ḡil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: Jephthah judged Israel six years and when he . . . died he was buried in one of the cities of Gilead
verses.literalPt: E Jefté julgou a Israel seis anos; e Jefté, o gileadita, faleceu, e foi sepultado numa das cidades de Gileade.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֤ט אַֽחֲרָיו֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִבְצָ֖ן מִבֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃
verses.literal: After Jephthah Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel
verses.literalPt: E depois dele julgou a Israel Ibzã de Belém.

verses.original: וַיְהִי־ ל֞וֹ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּנִ֗ים וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים בָּנוֹת֙ שִׁלַּ֣ח הַח֔וּצָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּנ֔וֹת הֵבִ֥יא לְבָנָ֖יו מִן־ הַח֑וּץ וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî- lōw šə·lō·šîm bā·nîm ū·šə·lō·šîm bā·nō·wṯ šil·laḥ ha·ḥū·ṣāh ū·šə·lō·šîm bā·nō·wṯ hê·ḇî lə·ḇā·nāw min- ha·ḥūṣ way·yiš·pōṭ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm
verses.literal: He had thirty sons as well as thirty daughters whom he gave in marriage to men outside his clan and for his sons he brought back thirty wives from elsewhere Ibzan judged Israel seven years
verses.literalPt: E tinha este trinta filhos, e trinta filhas que casou fora; e trinta filhas trouxe de fora para seus filhos; e julgou a Israel sete anos. 10 Então faleceu Ibzã, e foi sepultado em Belém.

verses.literal: Then Ibzan died and he was buried in Bethlehem

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֤ט אַֽחֲרָיו֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵיל֖וֹן הַזְּבֽוּלֹנִ֑י וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֶ֥שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·pōṭ ’a·ḥă·rāw ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ’ê·lō·wn haz·zə·ḇū·lō·nî way·yiš·pōṭ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘e·śer šā·nîm
verses.literal: After Ibzan Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel - - ten years
verses.literalPt: E depois dele julgou a Israel Elom, o zebulonita; e julgou a Israel dez anos.

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מָת אֵל֣וֹן הַזְּבֽוּלֹנִ֑י וַיִּקָּבֵ֥ר בְּאַיָּל֖וֹן בְּאֶ֥רֶץ זְבוּלֻֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ ’ê·lō·wn haz·zə·ḇū·lō·nî way·yiq·qā·ḇêr bə·’ay·yā·lō·wn bə·’e·reṣ zə·ḇū·lun
verses.literal: Then Elon the Zebulunite died and he was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun
verses.literalPt: E faleceu Elom, o zebulonita, e foi sepultado em Aijalom, na terra de Zebulom.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אַחֲרָ֖יו אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַבְדּ֥וֹן בֶּן־ הִלֵּ֖ל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִֽי׃
verses.literal: After Elon Abdon son of Hillel from Pirathon judged Israel
verses.literalPt: E depois dele julgou a Israel Abdom, filho de Hilel, o piratonita.

verses.original: וַיְהִי־ ל֞וֹ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים בָּנִ֗ים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים֙ בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים רֹכְבִ֖ים עַל־ שִׁבְעִ֣ים עֲיָרִ֑ם וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî- lōw ’ar·bā·‘îm bā·nîm ū·šə·lō·šîm bə·nê ḇā·nîm rō·ḵə·ḇîm ‘al- šiḇ·‘îm ‘ă·yā·rim way·yiš·pōṭ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl šə·mō·neh šā·nîm
verses.literal: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons . . . who rode on seventy donkeys And he judged Israel eight years
verses.literalPt: E tinha este quarenta filhos, e trinta netos, que cavalgavam sobre setenta jumentos; e julgou a Israel oito anos.

verses.original: וַיָּ֛מָת עַבְדּ֥וֹן בֶּן־ הִלֵּ֖ל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִ֑י וַיִּקָּבֵ֤ר בְּפִרְעָתוֹן֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֶפְרַ֔יִם בְּהַ֖ר הָעֲמָלֵקִֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ ‘aḇ·dō·wn ben- hil·lêl hap·pir·‘ā·ṯō·w·nî way·yiq·qā·ḇêr bə·p̄ir·‘ā·ṯō·wn bə·’e·reṣ ’ep̄·ra·yim bə·har hā·‘ă·mā·lê·qî
verses.literal: Then Abdon son of Hillel from Pirathon died and he was buried at Pirathon in Ephraim in the hill country of the Amalekites
verses.literalPt: Então faleceu Abdom, filho de Hilel, o piratonita; e foi sepultado em Piratom, na terra de Efraim, no monte dos amalequitas.
